forBeginners.title: The Jains
forBeginners.author: Paul Dundas
forBeginners.description: The most accessible and comprehensive introduction to Jain history, philosophy, and practice for English readers.

forBeginners.title: Jainism: An Indian Religion of Salvation
forBeginners.author: Helmuth von Glasenapp
forBeginners.description: A classic scholarly yet readable overview of Jainism's origins, development, and core teachings.

forBeginners.title: Jain Dharma
forBeginners.author: Acharya Shri Amar Muni
forBeginners.description: Clear, simple Hindi exposition of all Jain fundamentals — perfect for new seekers and children.

forBeginners.title: Jain Darshan
forBeginners.author: Tulsi (Acharya)
forBeginners.description: Concise presentation of Jain philosophy for lay readers, covering Tattvas, Karma, and Ratnatraya.

forBeginners.title: A to Z of Jainism
forBeginners.author: Kanti V. Mardia
forBeginners.description: An encyclopedia-style guide to every major Jain concept, place, festival, and figure.

forIntermediate.title: Tattvartha Sutra
forIntermediate.author: Acharya Umaswati (trans. Nathmal Tatia)
forIntermediate.description: The definitive philosophical manual. 357 sutras covering all of Jainism in its universal form.

forIntermediate.title: Sarvarthasiddhi
forIntermediate.author: Acharya Pujyapada (trans. S.A. Jain)
forIntermediate.description: The masterful commentary on Tattvartha Sutra — essential for any serious student.

forIntermediate.title: Gommatasara Karma Kanda
forIntermediate.author: Acharya Nemicandra (trans. R. Williams)
forIntermediate.description: The most comprehensive work on Karma theory — 148 types of karmas explained with remarkable precision.

forIntermediate.title: Aptamimansa
forIntermediate.author: Acharya Samantabhadra (trans. Sarat Chandra Ghoshal)
forIntermediate.description: Foundational work on Anekantavada and the nature of the omniscient teacher. A masterpiece of Jain logic.

forIntermediate.title: Samayasara
forIntermediate.author: Acharya Kundakunda (trans. A. Chakravarti)
forIntermediate.description: The crown jewel of Digambara philosophy — a direct path to self-realization through the pure soul.

forScholars.title: The Doctrine of the Jainas
forScholars.author: Walther Schubring
forScholars.description: The definitive German scholarly work on Jain doctrine, now available in English. The most rigorous academic analysis.

forScholars.title: Jain Philosophy: Historical Outline
forScholars.author: A.N. Upadhye
forScholars.description: Detailed historical survey of Jain philosophical development from Kundakunda to modern times.

forScholars.title: Prakrit Dictionary (Prakrit Abhidhan Kosh)
forScholars.author: Jain Vishva Bharati
forScholars.description: The most comprehensive dictionary of Prakrit words used in Jain scriptures, with Sanskrit and Hindi equivalents.

forScholars.title: Kalpa Sutra
forScholars.author: K.C. Lalwani (trans.)
forScholars.description: Critical edition with extensive notes on the Paryushan recitation text and biographies of the Tirthankaras.

forChildren.title: Jain Tirthankaras for Children
forChildren.author: Acharya Amar Muni
forChildren.description: Beautiful stories of the 24 Tirthankaras told in simple Hindi with colorful illustrations.

forChildren.title: Bal Bodh: Jain Stories for Kids
forChildren.author: JAINA Education Committee
forChildren.description: English-language storybook with 50+ Jain tales, activities, and moral lessons for ages 4-12.

forChildren.title: The Little Jain's Book of Values
forChildren.author: Various
forChildren.description: A colorful, interactive book introducing Ahimsa, Satya, Aparigraha, and daily practices through simple stories and coloring pages.

forChildren.title: Navkar Mantra - Learn and Sing
forChildren.author: JAINA
forChildren.description: An audio-visual learning kit for young children to learn the Navkar Mantra with melody, meaning, and gestures.

translations.title: Tattvartha Sutra (2005)
translations.author: Nathmal Tatia, translator
translations.significance: The most authoritative modern English translation with detailed commentary.

translations.title: Sarvarthasiddhi
translations.author: S.A. Jain, translator
translations.significance: Benchmark translation of Pujyapada's commentary on Tattvartha Sutra.

translations.title: Acharanga Sutra
translations.author: Hermann Jacobi (SBE 22)
translations.significance: Classic 19th-century translation from the Sacred Books of the East series.

translations.title: Uttaradhyayana Sutra
translations.author: Hermann Jacobi (SBE 45)
translations.significance: The canonical text of Mahavira's final teachings in classic English prose.

translations.title: Samayasara
translations.author: A. Chakravarti, translator
translations.significance: The essential text of self-realization by Kundakunda made accessible to English readers.

translations.title: Saman Suttam
translations.author: Jinendra Varni (Compiler)
translations.significance: The universal synthesis text accepted by all Jain traditions — an ideal starting text.

translations.title: Bhagavati Sutra
translations.author: K.C. Lalwani (trans.)
translations.significance: The massive 5th Anga containing 36,000 questions between Gautama and Mahavira.
